overview_description.description: Fuse Energy offers renewable electricity supply services, operating as a licensed energy supplier with integrated renewable generation assets and consumer-facing tariffs. The company sources power from solar and wind farms and manages its own retail operations to reduce intermediaries and pass savings to customers. It provides tools such as near real‑time billing forecasts updated every 30 minutes, mobile and web account management, and upcoming features like an AI assistant and smart device integration for home energy optimization.

about_short_description.short_description: Fuse Energy is an innovative energy company that simplifies gas and electricity management by providing accurate bill forecasts.

product.name: Fuse Home Energy
product.description: Residential gas and electricity supply with variable, fixed, EV, and multi-rate tariffs, plus bill forecasts updated every 30 minutes and account management through the Fuse app.

product.name: Fuse EV
product.description: An EV charging service that links home chargers to Fuse tariffs, schedules charging during lower-cost periods, and supports charger installation and related equipment sales.

product.name: Fuse Energy Network
product.description: A distributed-energy coordination service that connects smart meters, EV chargers, batteries, solar systems, and other devices to shift demand and support grid flexibility.

identifier.value: Fuse Store and Home Electrification Installations

product.name: Fuse Store and Home Electrification Installations
product.description: A marketplace for home energy equipment and installation services, including EV chargers, solar systems, batteries, heat pumps, smart thermostats, and selected connectivity products.

product.name: Fuse Business Energy
product.description: Business gas and electricity supply with bill forecasting, switching support, and management of multiple business locations from one account.

product.name: Renewable Energy Projects
product.description: Development and operation of renewable-energy sites, including solar and planned wind and hydrogen projects, with landowner partnerships and long-term site management.
